title: Theme manifest
description: Contract for a theme.yaml: the manifest that makes a theme a portable, ownable design bundle. Validated on load so a typo'd key fails clearly instead of being silently ignored.

themePath.description: A path relative to this theme directory, using forward slashes. A theme is untrusted data, so absolute paths and any path escaping the theme directory are refused at load — by the loader rather than by a schema `pattern`, which could only report the violation as a raw regex.

name.description: Theme identifier (the slug a book selects with `theme: <name>`). The only required field.

title.description: Human-facing display name for galleries/listings (defaults to `name`).

description.description: One-line description of the theme's look.

version.description: Theme version (semver recommended), independent of the ladle core version.

license.description: License for the theme's design assets (CSS/templates/patterns), distinct from any embedded font licenses.

tags.description: Mood/style/use-case tags for gallery filtering (e.g. [warm, rustic, serif]).

preview.description: Path (relative to this theme dir) to a generated preview image used by the gallery.

page.description: The physical book. Theme-owned: a book.yaml may not override it. `validate` checks the built PDF against this instead of against a constant, so a theme that prints another size is no longer reported as broken.

trim.description: Trim size as [width, height] CSS lengths, e.g. ['6.75in', '9.5in']. Must agree with what the theme's own `@page { size }` sets.

stylesheets.description: Stylesheets to load per output target, in cascade order. Paths are relative to this theme directory and may not escape it. Theme-owned: a book overrides a stylesheet by file, not by value.

print.description: Stylesheets linked into the print HTML (the PDF). Later entries win, and the design tokens are injected after all of them.

epub.description: Stylesheets passed to pandoc for the EPUB.

templates.description: Which template renders which output target. Names are relative to this theme's templates/ directory, so they read the same way a {% extends %} inside a template does.

print.description: Template rendering the print HTML (the PDF).

landing.description: Optional download page for the built book. A theme that ships no landing template simply produces no landing page.

palette.description: Default design-token colours (name -> hex); a book.yaml overrides any key.

labels.description: Printed strings this theme uses, and their defaults. Keys are the theme's own — a theme that prints a dedication page declares the word here. ladle keeps English fallbacks for the strings it knows about, and warns when a theme prints one it never declared. A book.yaml overrides any key.

params.description: Layout knobs this theme exposes, with their defaults. Free-form: the theme owns the vocabulary, and a book.yaml overrides any key it declares. Every theme knob belongs here rather than as a new top-level book.yaml field.

fonts.description: Default font-family roles (role -> family name); a book.yaml overrides any key.

font_faces.description: Font files embedded in the PDF (@font-face) and EPUB.

family.description: CSS font-family name this file provides.

file.description: Font file under this theme's fonts/ directory.

style.description: Font style this face covers (default: normal).

fonts_meta.description: License provenance per embedded font family (name/license/source).

source.description: Where the font was obtained (URL or foundry).
